m: jetṛ mfn. victorious, triumphant, gaining, (m.) conqueror, RV.; AV. &c.
jetṛ m. N. of a son of Madhucchandas (author of RV. i, 11), RAnukr.
of a prince who had a grove near Śrāvastī (cf. ˚ta-vana), Buddh.
a: jetṛ a. [ji-tṛc] 1 Victorious, triumphant. 2 Surpassing, excelling. — m. 1 A conqueror, victor. 2 An epithet of Viṣṇu.
